mentions.name: videofn
mentions.description: AI-assisted video editing tool for creating videos with kinetic text synced to audio. It uses a strong feedback loop so the agent can self-correct, and runs local models and rendering to keep as much of the process on device as possible. Originally an experiment, it grew into a useful tool and was recently released generally.
mentions.problem: Videos with lots of kinetic text synced to audio always took ages to make.
